title: If You’re Waiting for the Silver or Gold Crash, You Need to See This
speaker: Jordan Roy-Byrne

macro_themes.view: Gold's 2024 breakout from a 13-year cup and handle launched a multi-year secular bull; current drop mirrors the 2008 correction and most price damage is done.

Allocation to precious metals (~3.7%) and miners is far below 2008; the big rotation into gold needs a major stock-market decline, which he sees possible in 18-24 months as the AI bubble nears a secular top.
Fed (max 4%) is well behind the ~5% 2-year yield and likely hikes 2-3 more times; a peak and rollover in the 2-year yield will mark the impulsive gold low.
GVZ near an 8-month low and Bollinger width at an 18-month low: no crash or huge move for the next couple of months; volatility subdued into 2027.

calls.condition: Likely retests its low, possibly a false break lower that becomes the bottom; first low possibly in October, another before the Fed's last hike; then grinds back to 5,000 once the market sniffs the Fed is done.
calls.reason: Secular bull market intact; correction has more time to run; low volatility rules out a crash; 2-year yield peak is the signal for the next leg.
calls.quote: then the market sniffs the Fed is probably done, then it grinds higher back to 5,000

calls.condition: Likely comes back to the prior low near 55 for a double bottom, or a false break below 55 that marks the low before rebounding.
calls.reason: Breakout came all the way back to the trend line; technical support for the breakout at 50.55; still in a secular bull market after a ~55% correction similar to 2008.
calls.quote: This looks like it's going to come back down here. It's ripe to make a double bottom

calls.condition: Low-risk entry when % of GDXJ stocks above the 200-day falls to ~20% or lower (now 52%) along with price at support.
calls.reason: Price action short-term bearish below the 50/200-day MAs, but % above 20-day near zero suggests a short-term bounce; strong support at 103-106 and rising long-term MAs.
calls.quote: that, along with the price action here, is going to signal a low risk entry point in minors.

notes: No calendar date spoken; host says silver 'closed today' and wishes viewers 'a great weekend ahead', implying recorded after the close on Friday Oct 2, 2026 (listing approx_date 2026-10-03). Silver price 60 is his rough close ('I think it's 60 bucks'). GDXJ (junior miners) normalised to GDX per spec; levels are in GDXJ units. Gold short-term 'bearish' reflects his expected retest of the lows, though he also flags a possible near-term bounce; no current gold price given. He rejects a 50% crash to 3,200.
